title.en: The Price Is on the Back

caption.en: Every offer has a second page. Most people stop at the first.
caption.ko: 모든 제안에는 뒷장이 있다. 대부분은 앞장에서 멈춘다.

en: The price sat on the back.

moral.en: The front page was the offer. The back page was the price.

cta.en: Next time, flip the page over.
cta.ko: 다음에 손에 쥔 종이, 뒤집어 보면 된다.

narration.en: I didn't know then. The price tag was on the back.
narration.ko: 나는 그때 몰랐다. 값표는 뒤에 붙어 있었다.
